name: Hiyuki

tierList.prydwen: T0 Tower of Adversity, T0.5 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Glacio Sword main DPS centered on Glacio Chafe -> Glacio Bite conversion (like Zani's Frazzle/Heliacal Embers, but Bite is still a real Negative Status). Builds Dedication then Frostheart to enter 'Foreclaimed Self' and eventually an Iai-stance Basic Attack, finishing with a big enhanced Heavy/Ultimate burst.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Present Self (3 hits) / Foreclaimed Self (5 hits, Liberation DMG) both apply Glacio Chafe on later hits.
skills.resonanceSkill: Present Self (Frostblight) - Glacio strike; in Foreclaimed Self becomes Frostblight: Jade Cleave / Petalfall (pull + Chafe removal).
skills.forte: Everfrost Dominion - governs Dedication/Frostheart/Frostharden Iai/Whiteout Bitterfrost/Snowforged Blade resource chain and Glacio Bite conversion.
skills.liberation: Foreclaiming: Inward Vision (enter Foreclaimed Self) then Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation (Snowforged Blade-scaling finisher).
skills.intro: Frostedge - Glacio Liberation-type hit, applies Chafe, restores Dedication.
skills.outro: Snowlight Blessing - 20% Glacio DMG Amplify to teammates against Chafe-afflicted targets for 20s.

bestWeapons: Emerald of Genesis (79.2%, best F2P standard-banner)
Fables of Wisdom (best fully F2P craftable)
echoSet: Wishes of Quiet Snowfall (100%, best - huge CRIT Rate + Glacio DMG)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Lucilla/Lynae are her only competitive buffers; Chisa/Lucilla stack her Fine Snow passive (needs teammates applying Glacio Chafe/Havoc Bane).

teams.name: Alternative Teams
teams.notes: Significant drop-off without Chisa/Lucilla/Lynae/Suisui/Mornye backing her up.

rotation: Intro -> Basic 3 -> Heavy: Frost Splinter (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate: Inward Vision -> Foreclaimed Basic 1,2,3 (cancel via Skill) -> Skill: Jade Cleave -> Petalfall -> Foreclaimed Basic 1,2,3 (cancel via Dodge) -> Dodge -> Iai Basic x3 -> Heavy: Bitterfrost -> hold Ultimate: Blade Liberation -> Skill (swap) -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: best Glacio DPS by a huge margin in her best team, strong multi-wave capability from AoE hits and built-in grouping, near-permanent invulnerability/pause windows during long animations. Main weakness is a narrow teammate pool (Lucilla/Lynae + Chisa essentially mandatory), making her less F2P-friendly than comparable DPS like Aemeath.
